messages.subject: display error
parts:
Dear all,
I'm new to exon analysis by R and started using this package last
month! I've managed to reach the Quality assessment of PLM fit but
cannot generate the spatial false-colored images of the residuals. I
get an error message (in Firefox): "Error in
explorer.onChipType().Unknown chip Type: HuEx-1_0-st-v2".
What am i doing wrong?
Thanks,
Maria

Here is my code:
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("HuEx-1_0-st-
v2,core,A20071112,EP")
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("PC3DataSet",chipType="HuEx-1_0-st-
v2")
setCdf(cs, cdf)
bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs, tag="BCcoreCDF")
csBC <- process(bc,verbose=verbose)
setCdf(csBC,cdf)
qn <- QuantileNormalization(csBC, typesToUpdate="pm",tags="QNcore")
csN <- process(qn)
plmTr <- ExonRmaPlm(csN, mergeGroups=TRUE)
print(plmTr)
fit(plmTr, verbose=verbose)
rs <- calculateResiduals(plmTr, verbose=verbose)
ae <- ArrayExplorer(rs)
setColorMaps(ae, c("log2,log2neg,rainbow", "log2,log2pos,rainbow"))
process(ae, interleaved="auto", verbose=verbose)
display(ae)

Also my sessionInfo is:

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] display error
parts:
Hi Maria,

I don't have a clue about the firefox error, but aroma.affymetrix saves
the files so if you didn't get an R error they are probably sitting on
your hard drive as .png files so you can look at them even if you are
having a problem with the firefox application for viewing them in a nice
way. It will be something like
'../reports/PC3DataSet/RBC,QN,RMA,merged,ensb/HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20071112/spatial'

If the files are not there (or not all of them), then that would also be
useful to report this for error checking.

Another thing to note about the exon array is that many of the residuals
will not have real values (they will be NA or -Inf or something like
that on the log scale). This is because most of the probes (~75%) will
not have been fitted since you are using the core probesets. So it's
quite possible that you will not get very easy to interpret results.
There are also strange block patterns, which we think are due to the
location of the control probes but it is not quite explained. See this
previous discussion ('Quality Assessment'):
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/browse_thread/thread/a27c45becb803387#

Best,
Elizabeth

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] display error
parts:
Hi,

thinks you've spotted a bug in ArrayExplorer that happens when one use
CDFs (chip types) with tags. I think I've corrected it and the bug
fix will be available in the next release.

Cheers

Henrik
